text_block_list.text:
Today is training in racewear. El Condor 
Pasa was running the track with even more 
energy than usual.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Feelin' good, feelin' great, at the 
absolute peak! El is the world's strongest 
again todaaay!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wearing my racing silks really does get me 
fired up after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it might not just be the 
effect of the outfit!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yesterday, I actually sent Papa a 
photo of me in my racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Papa liked it too, and the two of us 
talked about our passion for the GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm fully fired up! El's 
dream is just within reach, yesss!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"With this racing attire, El will prove to 
the world that she is the strongest!"

She must really love her racing silks, 
because El Condor Pasa seems to be in 
extremely high spirits.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heheh, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My papa gave me this mask, desu, but this 
racing outfit is something El picked out 
herself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It is filled with my very own special 
feelings, YEEESSS!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Trainer, I'm sure you 
understand, yes!
choice_data_list: Like, your resolve toward your dream?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Trainer-san, you're quite the 
passionate person, aren't you! As 
expected, *deeesu*! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, exactly! I will defeat my rival! And 
prove that I am the world's strongeeeest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"This racing attire carries that very 
determination within it!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer, please come with me 
for a second!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The smartphone is all set! Now, strike a 
pose!
choice_data_list: What is it all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was just a photo of El, but 
Trainer, you're chasing the dream right 
beside me too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So this time, the two of us will strike a 
pose and send a photo of our resolve to 
Papa, YESSS!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Fitting for a condor, with the vast sky 
as the backdrop, with a boom!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"A pose fitting for a duo would be great, 
desu! Maybe cross our arms raising them to 
the sky—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Maybe El should give Trainer-san a 
piggyback ride too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Like what you usually do for your 
cornerman, that kind of thing, yes! Now 
then, Trainer, over here!

Passing on the piggyback ride, they 
instead sent a photo of the two of them 
raising their arms toward the vast sky.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: CORREEEECT! As expected of my Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, there's only one 
thing to doooo! Now, let us be off!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Conquering any hill in her path! Her name 
is El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Carrying all feelings and expectations, 
pushing forward! The world's strongest, El 
Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how rough the road may be! El 
Condor Pasa will keep on running!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My vow to be the world's strongest goes 
into this mask! And what goes into this 
racing suit is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Challenging our dreams! Conviction! 
Determination! YESSS!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... *pant*, *pant*...! To prove I'm the 
strongest in the world...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's build the ultimate body 
together, I'm counting on you...!

El Condor Pasa pushed through training on 
sheer momentum and ended up completely 
exhausted, but—

Her expression cleared, and a renewed 
sense of resolve could be seen on her 
face.
